source: Elena FF, Rigged hand, CC BY-SA 4.0
canonicalBasis: +Y fingers, -Z palm, +Z dorsal, -X thumb, wrist origin, metres
thumbLocalQuaternionOrder: Arrays below are standard glTF/PlayCanvas XYZW order, applied after sampling the source clip.
method: Evaluate the original skin and source clip at 0.47 seconds. Hold thumb_base.R_03 and the other source joints at that sample. Optimize local rotation-vector deltas on thumb_01.R_08, thumb_02.R_09 and thumb_03.R_010 against the three target joint positions with residual ((position-target)*1000, deltaRadians*0.2), least squares initialized at zero deltas. Blend open-time-zero local rotations toward the resulting local quaternion endpoints with the interaction's grip fraction. This adapts the authored rig pose, not the hand mesh.
